parameters.name: DataPolicy
parameters.description:
The data migration policy. Valid values:

*   abandon: does not migrate data. This is the default value.
*   force_transfer: forcibly migrates data.
*   try_transfer: Migrate data as much as possible.

parameters.name: EventId
parameters.description: The ID of the system event.

parameters.name: OpsType
parameters.description:
The type of the O\&M task. Valid values:

*   immediate
*   scheduled

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description:
The password of the instance. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, a random password is used.

The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length. The password must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

Note that you cannot enter a password for scheduled execution.

parameters.name: PlanTime
parameters.description: The execution time of the reservation. The timestamp is measured in milliseconds. If the OpsType parameter is set to scheduled, this parameter is required.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens event-migrate-instance --event-id e-d71ff150945b9c02eb6ebc0016328468 --resource-id i-55qi8m11rr53c4i964md8a00l --ops-type immediate --plan-time 1742452232000 --plan-utc-time example-string --data-policy abandon --password AAaa1234 --region cn-hangzhou
